description: SDIS25 - Centres de secours du Doubs is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SDIS25. Pompiers du Doubs - Liste des centres de secours du Doubs. Coverage: SDIS25. The publisher named on the listing is SDIS25. Its keywords include justice-securite-police-crime. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2021-10-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
